acceptance.artifact: workstreams/po03/holdout/ suite plus a freeze manifest with hashes
acceptance.assertion: At least 20 executable novel cases are committed and pushed before any generation source is read, provable from git history. Each case cites the commission requirement it tests, is runnable against any generation through a documented interface, and is not a restatement of a public-suite case. The author confirms in writing that no a8 source was read before the freeze commit.
acceptance.falsified_if: git history shows a8 source was read before the freeze, or any case duplicates a public-suite case

hypothesis: A holdout suite can be authored from the commission's acceptance criteria alone, without reading any generation, and will be materially harder than the public suite because it was never available to optimise against.

source_hashes.note: Pinned by commit, per the a12-u02 remediation.
